newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Monday.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Monday.

text.p: Spot product prices in the U.S. Northwest remained notionally flat on Monday, tracking range-bound California gasoline values.
Conventional-grade California gasoline slipped a half cent after slight gains early on Monday. The final range was between 63 and 64 cents a gallon, with buyers sidelined by volatile NYMEX action.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline stayed notionally unchanged at 61/62 cents a gallon.
Seattle low sulphur diesel remained 75/76 cents and jet fuel remained 75/76 cents a gallon.
Tosco Corp cut crude oil runs at its Northern California refinery by 10,000 barrels per day, but traders saw no signficant impact on product prices.
